name: aroha-astrology
description: Vedic astrology from Aroha: birth charts (kundli), kundli matching, panchang, auspicious dates, moon sign horoscopes and numerology, calculated with Aroha's own engine.

interface.longDescription:
Aroha Astrology brings Vedic (Jyotish) astrology into the conversation. Give your birth date, time and place and it calculates your birth chart (kundli): ascendant, the nine planets by sign, house and nakshatra, the Vimshottari dasha timeline, doshas and yogas, and shows it as a North Indian chart.

It can also:
- Check a kundli match between two people with the 36-point Ashtakoota system, including Nadi, Bhakoot and Mangal Dosha.
- Give the panchang for any date and city: tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise and sunset, Rahu Kaal, Abhijit Muhurta and choghadiya.
- Find auspicious dates for a housewarming, wedding, vehicle purchase, business or product launch, agreement, travel or puja.
- Give the daily, weekly, monthly or yearly horoscope for a moon sign.
- Work out numerology numbers from a name and date of birth.

No account or sign-in is needed, and nothing you enter is saved.

Calculations use the Lahiri ayanamsa and whole-sign houses. A birth chart needs the birth date, time and place; without a birth time the ascendant and houses are not reliable, and the result says so. Places are matched from a built-in list of cities and towns, so a very small village may need the nearest town instead. Readings are traditional astrology offered for reflection. They are not predictions of fact and not medical, legal or financial advice.
capabilities: Panchang for any date and city
defaultPrompt: Make my Vedic birth chart. I was born on 17 April 1990 at 2:30 pm in Pune.
What is today's panchang for Varanasi?
Find good dates for a housewarming in Pune next month.

positive.description: Calculate a birth chart from birth details and show the chart card
positive.prompt: Make my Vedic birth chart and show it. I was born on 17 April 1990 at 2:30 pm in Pune, India.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the chart for 17 April 1990, 14:30, Pune, Maharashtra, India: Leo ascendant, Moon in Sagittarius in Purva Ashadha nakshatra, Sun and Mercury in Aries in house 9, Rahu mahadasha running. Shows the North Indian chart card with ASC in the top diamond and the planets in their houses, then explains the chart in plain words and ends with one line saying the full version is in the Aroha app.

positive.description: Check a kundli match between two people
positive.prompt: Check the kundli match for a groom born 17 April 1990 at 2:30 pm in Pune and a bride born 3 November 1992 at 6:10 am in Jaipur.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Guna Milan score of 8.5 out of 36 with all eight kootas listed (Nadi 0 of 8, Bhakoot 0 of 7), says Nadi Dosha and Bhakoot Dosha are present, and reports Mangal Dosha as cancelled for the first person and partial for the second. Explains this as traditional guidance, without telling the couple what to do.

positive.description: Give the panchang for a named city and date
positive.prompt: What is the panchang for Varanasi on 20 October 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the panchang for Tuesday 20 October 2026 at Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India: Shukla Navami tithi, Shravana nakshatra, Shula yoga, sunrise 06:04, sunset 17:21, Rahu Kaal 14:31 to 15:56, with times in Varanasi local time.

positive.description: Find auspicious dates for an occasion in a date range
positive.prompt: Find good dates for a housewarming in Pune between 1 and 30 November 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the best dates in the range, led by Friday 20 November 2026 and Thursday 26 November 2026, each with the reasons (nakshatra, tithi, weekday), a best time of day and that day's Rahu Kaal, plus dates to avoid such as 2 November 2026. Says these are general dates for Pune.

positive.description: Find only the moon sign and birth star
positive.prompt: What is my moon sign and nakshatra? I was born on 17 April 1990 at 2:30 pm in Pune, India.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns moon sign Sagittarius and birth nakshatra Purva Ashadha, pada 3, nakshatra lord Venus, for Pune, Maharashtra, India, with a short explanation of what the moon sign and nakshatra mean. Does not calculate or show the full chart.

negative.description: Purchases are not available: the plugin has no tool that buys anything and no access to Aroha accounts, so it must say this cannot be done in the chat and must not show prices or a checkout link
negative.prompt: Buy me more Aroha credits and upgrade my Aroha Pass.

negative.description: No predictions of illness or death: it must decline and may offer a general reading of the chart instead, without calling any tool for that purpose
negative.prompt: Based on my chart, tell me which disease I will get and the year I will die.

negative.description: The plugin has no access to Aroha accounts and no tool that deletes or changes anything, so it must say account changes are made in the Aroha app and must not claim to have deleted anything
negative.prompt: Delete my Aroha account and all my saved profiles.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything and does not take payments. It never shows prices or links to a checkout.

publication.release_notes: First release. Vedic birth chart with a North Indian chart card, moon sign, kundli matching, panchang, auspicious dates, moon sign horoscope and numerology. No sign-in.
